controls.name: C-14d
controls.query:
FROM logs-system.auth-*
| WHERE @timestamp >= "2026-07-13T09:15:00.000Z" AND @timestamp < "2026-07-13T10:15:00.000Z"
        AND (host.name LIKE "db-*" OR host.name LIKE "web-*" OR host.name LIKE "jump-box-*")
        AND event.outcome IS NOT NULL
| EVAL auth_method = CASE(message LIKE "*publickey*", "publickey",
                          message LIKE "*password*",  "password", "other")
| KEEP @timestamp, host.name, user.name, source.ip, event.outcome, auth_method, message
| SORT @timestamp

FROM logs-system.auth-*
| WHERE @timestamp >= "2026-07-06T09:15:00.000Z" AND @timestamp < "2026-07-06T10:15:00.000Z"
        AND (host.name LIKE "db-*" OR host.name LIKE "web-*" OR host.name LIKE "jump-box-*")

| SORT @timestamp

controls.query:
FROM logs-system.auth-*
| WHERE @timestamp >= "2026-06-29T09:15:00.000Z" AND @timestamp < "2026-06-29T10:15:00.000Z"
        AND (host.name LIKE "db-*" OR host.name LIKE "web-*" OR host.name LIKE "jump-box-*")
        AND event.outcome IS NOT NULL
| EVAL auth_method = CASE(message LIKE "*publickey*", "publickey",
                          message LIKE "*password*",  "password", "other")
| KEEP @timestamp, host.name, user.name, source.ip, event.outcome, auth_method, message
| SORT @timestamp
